notes.title: The game is finally going on sale!
notes.content:
After more than a year of development, "Detective Super Star" is finally going on steam. The distribution time is February 9(Thursday), and the price is $1.99, with 10% discount in the first week .

This version of game for sale is the full version, including all 5 chapters of content.

Welcome to download and play "Detective Super Star".

By the way, if you haven't added a wishlist yet, hurry up and add one.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2153590/_/

notes.title: Welcome to Detective Super Star PlayTest!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Detective Super Star is now in PlayTest.

Click the Request Access button in the Steam Store of Detective Super Star, then you will be qualified to download the latest version of Detective Super Star now.

Store link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2153590/_/

Please enjoy the game, and by the way, if you are interested on Detective Super Star, wishlist now!
